purpose: the SIN and COS curves against the rotor angle, at any air gap

coordinates.model_origin: the rotation axis, at the top face of the stator's F.Cu copper
coordinates.z: z up, from the stator towards the rotor. Stator F.Cu top face at z = 0, B.Cu at z = -0.8

rotor.placement: copper side towards the stator, not mirrored, its copper face at z = +air_gap

air_gap_definition: stator F.Cu top face to rotor copper face (copper to copper)

TX.source: the two free ends of the TX copper in Stator.kicad_pcb, stacked at one point (as Parameters.txt's lead-cutting suggestion)
TX.how: the two coil ends lie stacked at this point on the two layers; the terminal goes between them

2.source: the generator found no cut spot; the layer-change via farthest from the TX copper (4.00 mm), of those the farthest from the TX ends
2.how: a 0.2 mm gap cut across the top trace at cut.xy_kicad (the via at via_xy_kicad stays); the terminal is across the gap

cut.source: the spot on the top trace nearest the via, 0.86 mm from it, with 0.46 mm of free board round the cut, as on S0_1x_OD22_2L_tiny_TXtop_Cut
